optical_colour_index_method: Derived from relative TCS34725 channel intensities using standard luma weighting. OCI = 1.0 - (0.2126*R + 0.7152*G + 0.0722*B)/Clear. Synthetically generated for demonstration; not scientifically calibrated.

demonstration_events.description: Sediment disturbance at inlet pipe causing high turbidity spike (peak 6.35 NTU > 5.0 NTU limit). Triggers HIGH_TURBIDITY alert.
Mineral-rich municipal water inflow causing elevated dissolved solids (peak 542 ppm > 500 ppm limit). Triggers ELEVATED_TDS alert.
Acidic stagnation / atmospheric rainwater ingress causing pH depression (trough 6.18 < 6.5 limit). Triggers ACIDIC_WATER alert.
